(Senior) Site Specialist (f/m/d)

Date: 08/05/2026
Company: SAP

We help the world run better
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

What you'll build

SAP has founded the Delos Cloud GmbH to deliver a vendor and solution-neutral sovereign cloud and accelerate the digital transformation of public services in Germany. Catering to the need for digitization in the public sector, the new company will act as a trusted partner providing an open sovereign cloud platform. With Sovereignty and Security at its heart, the cloud infrastructure offering is designed to meet the strict and unique national requirements set out by the German Government’s multi-cloud strategy.

Your responsibilities include:

Delos Cloud GmbH is growing and we are looking for a Physical Security (Senior) Specialist (f/m/d) for our existing and planned locations in Walldorf, Berlin and Frankfurt.

Do you enjoy and are passionate about being jointly responsible for implementing a safe working environment for our employees and protecting the assets of our young, up-and-coming company? Do you understand security as a holistic model in which responsibility and commitment are central pillars? Then apply now as a Physical Security (Senior) Specialist (f/m/d) to make Germany's digital future a little safer.

- You plan, implement and monitor all security measures for the company's locations assigned to you.
- Development and implementation of security policies, procedures and programs.
- You ensure that all security measures comply with applicable laws, regulations, certification and security standards especially related to sovereign Data Centers.
- You keep yourself up to date with current developments in the field of security and adapt security strategies and measures accordingly.
- You design concepts for security systems and infrastructures, considering the specific requirements and risks of the company or facilities. This includes identifying security gaps, selecting suitable technologies and developing solutions to ward off threats.
- You implement and operate access control measures according to national security and secrecy requirements.
- You ensure adherence to the federal government’s physical security demands including sabotage protection
- You work closely with external partners and internal teams such as facility management, the security team and on-site employees to build a comprehensive security infrastructure.

What you bring

- Completed degree in a security-related field or several years of professional experience in the security industry or a security-related authority (military, police, intelligence service), ideally in a managerial position.
- Comprehensive knowledge of security concepts, methods and technologies, ideally in data center security or in securing areas with high protection requirements.
- Extensive experience in the areas of: perimeter protection, mechanical burglary protection, locking mechanics and mechatronics, access control systems, burglar alarm systems and video surveillance.
- Experience in the development and implementation of security strategies and measures for locations or facilities.
- Strong understanding of compliance requirements and security standards. (IT-Grundschutz, C5, KRITIS, DIN 50600,..)
- Leadership skills and the ability to train, lead and motivate a security team.
- Ability to work effectively in a global and diverse environment.
- Do you respond to developments in the situation with fun and flexibility and are you an absolute team player?
- Excellent German language skills both in written and spoken language; English skills both in written and spoken language
- Residing in Walldorf / Berlin / Frankfurt (or) direct surroundings
- Regular mandatory on-call duty for night-time and weekend coverage required
- Willingness to go through personal security clearance (Government process)

Where you belong

SAP Government Security and Secrecy (GS2) organization is part of the SAP Customer Services and Delivery Board Area. This organization ensures strict liability fulfillment of customers’ national security requirements, business enablement in sensitive industries and compliance with Critical Infrastructure as well as Telecommunication regulations for SAP world-wide.

​

Bring out your best
SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.

We win with inclusion
SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.

SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.

Join us and be part of a dynamic company shaping the future of energy!

Zweck und Ziel der Stelle
As a Technical Sales und Application Engineer (m/f/d), for chassis components, rolling und sliding elements, you will be the key link between our customers, salesteam, engineering, production, and quality departments. You will help transform customer requirements into technical solutions and contribute to long-term customer satisfaction and business growth.
This role is ideal for an engineer who is passionate about product development, technical problemsolving, and close collaboration with customer engineering teams. You will coordinate engineering activities across global teams, drive technical discussions, and help deliver high-quality solutions for international customers. If you enjoy working in a multicultural environment and acting as a key technical interface between customers and engineering teams worldwide, we would love to hear from you.Aufgaben, Kompetenzen und Verantwortung✓ Collaborate closely with customers and the sales team to understand technical requirements and application needs.✓ Evaluate customer inquiries and identify technically feasible and commercially viable solutions.✓ Support customer visits, technical discussions, and project meetings throughout the sales process.✓ Serve as the primary technical interface between customer engineering teams and our internal manufacturing, engineering, and quality functions.✓ Review technical drawings, specifications, and test requirements, ensuring clear communication both internally and externally.✓ Coordinate and manage technical documentation, including drawings, samples, ISIRs, PPAPs, and other customer-specific requirements.✓ Analyze customer complaints, field returns, and test results, driving root cause discussions and corrective actions.✓ Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and support the creation and maintenance of quality management documentation.✓ Work within international cross-functional teams to ensure successful project execution and customer satisfaction.
Fachliche Anforderungen✓ Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related technical discipline.✓ Experience in industrial manufacturing and/or the automotive industry is an advantage.✓ Knowledge of rolling or sliding elements, chassis components, suspension systems, or comparable applications is preferred.✓ Ability to interpret and work confidently with technical drawings, specifications, and engineering documentation.✓ Strong customer orientation and the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly.✓ Willingness to travel for customer meetings and project-related activities.✓ Excellent communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus.✓ Self-driven, structured, and solution-oriented working style.✓ Hands-on mindset combined with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.✓ Team player who enjoys working in an international environment.
Arbeitgeberleistungen / Unternehmensangebot✓ A challenging position with a high level of responsibility and customer interaction.✓ The opportunity to work with leading international customers in the automotive and industrial sectors.✓ A collaborative and international working environment.✓ Flat hierarchies and short decision-making processes.✓ Professional development and growth opportunities.✓ The chance to actively shape technical solutions and contribute to business success.

Zweck und Ziel der Stelle
As a Project Manager Sales (m/f/d) for chassis components, rolling und sliding elements, you will drive customer projects from initial inquiry through successful series production. Combining strong technical understanding with commercial awareness, you will act as the central point of contact for customers and internal stakeholders, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and to the highest quality standards.This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys working with customers, managing complex projects, and driving business success. If you combine technical expertise with commercial thinking and thrive in an international environment, we would love to hear from you.Aufgaben, Kompetenzen und Verantwortung✓ Lead customer projects from quotation phase through industrialization and series production.✓ Act as the primary interface between customers and internal departments, including Engineering, Quality and Supply Chain.✓ Build strong customer relationships and identify opportunities for business growth and long-term partnerships.✓ Manage project timelines, milestones, risks, and deliverables to ensure successful project execution.✓ Coordinate and support technical and commercial discussions with customers.✓ Review customer requirements, technical specifications, drawings, and feasibility assessments together with engineering teams.✓ Drive cross-functional project meetings and ensure clear communication across all stakeholders.✓ Monitor project costs, quotations, and commercial performance throughout the project lifecycle.✓ Support contract negotiations and customer agreements in close cooperation with sales management.✓ Identify and mitigate project risks while developing effective solutions to technical and commercial challenges.✓ Ensure customer expectations regarding quality, cost, and delivery are consistently achieved.✓ Support continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to the development of project management best practices.
Fachliche Anforderungen✓ Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a comparable technical discipline.✓ Several years of experience in project management, technical sales, account management, or a related customer-facing role.✓ Strong engineering background with the ability to understand technical drawings, specifications, manufacturing processes, and product requirements.✓ Experience within the automotive, industrial, or manufacturing sector is highly desirable.✓ Commercial understanding and ability to balance technical and business objectives.✓ Excellent organizational and project management skills.✓ Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation abilities.✓ Ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously.✓ Proactive, solution-oriented, and customer-focused mindset.✓ Fluent English skills, both written and spoken; additional languages are an advantage.✓ Willingness to travel within Europe and internationally as required.
Arbeitgeberleistungen / Unternehmensangebot✓ A key role with direct impact on customer success and business growth.✓ Exciting international projects within a dynamic and innovative environment.✓ High level of responsibility and visibility across the organization.✓ Close collaboration with sales, engineering, quality, and operations teams.✓ Opportunities for professional growth and career development.✓ Flat hierarchies, short decision-making processes, and entrepreneurial culture.✓ A competitive compensation package and the chance to work with leading customers in the automotive and industrial sectors.

What you will do

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

Discover Impactful Work

As a Sales Engineer Gauging within the Production Process & Analytics (PPA) business unit of the Chemical Analysis Division (CAD) at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will play a key role in driving commercial success across our Quality Control Systems portfolio.

You will be responsible for developing new business opportunities while growing existing customer relationships across assigned industrial markets and territory. Reporting to the Global Commercial Leader, you will execute strategic sales initiatives, identify opportunities for market expansion, and deliver value-driven solutions that help customers improve their manufacturing processes.

Your technical expertise, consultative selling approach, and ability to build lasting customer partnerships will be essential in achieving sales objectives and supporting the continued growth and profitability of the business.

A Day in the Life:

- Achieve assigned bookings, revenue and profitability targets.
- Develop and execute territory sales plans to identify and secure new business opportunities.
- Manage the complete sales cycle from prospecting and qualification through quotation, negotiation and closing.
- Identify AI-enabled solutions and digital services to support business growth and deliver measurable customer value.
- Maintain an accurate sales forecast and opportunity pipeline using Salesforce.com.
- Collaborate with partners and representatives to support commercial growth.
- Provide valuable market intelligence by monitoring market trends, competitive activities and customer-specific requirements.
- Develop trusted relationships with existing and prospective customers.
- Analyze customer production processes and recommend technical solutions that improve quality, productivity and operational efficiency.
- Engage customers with AI-enabled discussions and commercial solutions.
- Deliver outstanding customer experience through responsiveness, technical expertise and solution-oriented support.
- Demonstrate and present the technical capabilities and business value of Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Quality Control Systems.
- Collaborate closely with application specialists, service engineers, software experts and product management to develop customer-specific solutions.
- Maintain a high level of product, application, industry and AI knowledge to effectively position our solutions.
- Travel throughout the assigned territory and internationally as required, with approximately 50% overnight travel.

What to expect:

- Drive sales growth by achieving commercial targets across the assigned territory.
- Identify and develop new business opportunities while expanding existing customer relationships.
- Lead complex technical sales engagements from prospecting through contract negotiation and closing.
- Deliver consultative, value-based sales solutions tailored to customer manufacturing processes.
- Work cross-functionally with technical experts, service teams and product management.
- Utilize Salesforce.com to manage opportunities, forecasting and customer engagement.
- Monitor market trends and competitive activities to support strategic business growth.
- Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific through regular customer visits and extensive travel.

Keys to Success:

Education

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Physics, Materials Science, or another relevant technical discipline, or equivalent technical experience.

Experience

- Minimum of 3 years of successful technical sales experience in capital equipment, industrial instrumentation, process analytics or industrial automation.
- Proven experience selling complex technical solutions to manufacturing customers.
- Experience within one or more of the following industries is highly desirable:
- Metal
- Packaging & Converting
- Battery Manufacturing
- Experience working with distributors or channel partners is desirable.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

- Strong consultative selling and negotiation skills with a customer-focused mindset.
- Excellent presentation and communication skills for both technical and business audiences.
- Ability to understand complex manufacturing processes and translate them into customer-focused technical solutions.
- Understanding of AI and digital technologies as emerging commercial enablers within industrial markets.
- Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
- Experience using CRM systems (Salesforce.com preferred) together with digital sales and collaboration tools.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
- Fluency in German and English (written and spoken).
- Additional language skills are an advantage.
- Valid driver's license and willingness to travel extensively.

Benefits:

We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!

Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need.

The Role

We are looking for a Team Lead of Project Engineering to lead our Product Engineering function and act as a key interface between R&D, Production, Operations and the wider business. This is a hands?on leadership role combining product engineering, compliance and quality management, ensuring robust release processes and high?quality, compliant products.

You will be responsible for structuring and running the “back?end” of R&D: establishing processes, managing documentation, guiding the team, and ensuring smooth transitions from development to production.

This is a highly visible on?site role within a collaborative R&D and production environment.

Key Responsibilities Product Engineering Leadership
• Lead and develop the Product Engineering team

• Coordinate cross?functionally with R&D, Operations, Supply Chain and Product Management to support smooth product launches

• Manage Product Engineering?related change and improvement processes across multiple departments

Compliance
• Coordinate compliance activities for all new products through pilot series
• Manage compliance challenges and escalations (e.g. customer?specific requirements)
• Organise and maintain compliance documentation
• Support CE and EMC/EMV?related activities
• Coordinate contributions from other departments where required
• Act as the internal interface to compliance experts (expert knowledge remains with the central compliance team)
• Support release processes requiring external compliance sign?off

Quality Management
• Take overall responsibility for internal production quality standards
• Establish systems to track, analyse and evaluate test and measurement data
• Ensure quality processes support production rather than create additional burden (smart, pragmatic tooling and workflows)
• Coordinate and support production in case of quality issues
• Act as R&D’s interface to the ISO responsible person, supporting: Process mapping and version control, Identification and closure of R&D process gaps in line with ISO requirements
• Drive the completion of documentation gaps within Product Engineering and coordinate closure across R&D

What We’re Looking For
• Strong experience with high?tech products in a product or project engineering environment
• Proven people leadership and team coordination experience
• Highly organised, structured, and pragmatic problem?solver
• Strong understanding of quality, compliance, release and industrialisation processes
• Background or training in Six Sigma, quality management or similar methodologies
• Experience working towards or within ISO?compliant environments
• Ability to balance “what is required” with a focus on delivering a truly excellent product
• Confident communicator, comfortable operating at the interface between engineering and the wider organisation
• Strong project management skills
• Willingness to attend training and further develop expertise in ISO, compliance and quality

EIT Health delivers a portfolio of collaborative projects, supported by diversity of funding sources. To ensure a steady pipeline of new opportunities EIT Health is recruiting a Senior Manager, New Opportunities Development. In this role, you will work closely with colleagues in the New Opportunities Development Unit under the Director of Community and Stakeholders Engagement and transversally with relevant business units at EIT Health that have potential to engage in EU funded projects. This role is not about inventing or delivering the underlying innovation itself, but about designing the structures, partnerships and funding pathways that allow others' innovations to be developed, tested and scaled through European collaborative projects. You will scout and prioritise funding opportunities (EU or national grants, philanthropic foundations, tenders), design new project applications, manage the end-to-end proposal development process, ensuring alignment with business needs target financing schemes.

• Lead and coordinate proposal development with different functions in the organisation, including project conceptualisation, proposal writing, budget preparation and consortium partner engagement.
• Act as the connective layer between innovators, funders and implementing teams, ensuring ideas are translated into fundable, well-structured project frameworks.
• Collaborate with external stakeholders (such as higher education institutions, research agencies, small and large companies, policy bodies, network organisations, etc.) to build collaborative consortia for joint proposals and bids, including leading on negotiations and alignment on roles, responsibilities and resources.
• Plan the transfer of awarded project proposals to the implementing units, including via administrative and contracting support.
• Maintain repositories, logs and dashboards of the opportunities pipeline and raise internal visibility of proposals under development.
• Collaborate closely with all business units at EIT Health to secure buy-in in proposals in the pipeline (asset management, profit growth, delivery, communications, stakeholder engagement, operations and finance functions) within the wider team and the overarching EIT Health organisation.
• Support post-project review, for internal learning.

Your skills & knowledge

• Experience designing innovation support models, frameworks or programme structures (e.g., accelerators, funding calls, matchmaking mechanisms) rather than conducting the underlying research or technology development.

• Proven experience with the EU Funding and Tenders Portal, with the ability to manage the proposal process independently.
• Familiarity with support tools that streamline proposal development (e.g., AI-assisted drafting tools, budget templates, consortium/partner databases, project management or CRM platforms).
• Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in complex and innovative environments, cross culturally in an international public-private context.
• Ability to operate both on a strategic and operational level with a clear customer service mindset and in an autonomous and agile manner under a remote-first, fast-paced environment.
